summary: This document outlines the SAWNERGY research pipeline, an end-to-end machine learning framework designed to quantify protein dynamics and guide drug discovery for mutant p53. The system extracts residue-level features from molecular dynamics trajectories, represents each simulation frame using tensors or graphs, and employs hierarchical autoencoders to learn trajectory-level embeddings. By establishing a wild-type dynamical reference distribution, the pipeline computes a dynamical rescue score measuring how effectively candidate compounds restore mutant Y220C dynamics toward normal behavior. A molecular surrogate model and generative diffusion model operate within an active learning loop to iteratively propose, evaluate, and optimize novel therapeutic compounds for experimentalists.
title: SAWNERGY: Refined End-to-End Research Pipeline
